# App Foundry 0.2.0 beta

App Foundry 0.2.0 public Android beta.

Four connected workspaces: Creator Forge, Automate (Alpha), Organise (Bravo), Manage (Charlie). The Android app loads the actual unified Foundry client hosted by SJ-INSIDES. Users' drafts, milestones, document reminders and business-admin entries are stored locally inside the app's WebView. No account, AI generation, online sync or payment processing is included.

Android downloads, JSON backup import/export, calendar reminders and profile image handling still require broader device testing. Backup files are unencrypted; keep them private. Internet connection is needed to load hosted interface. This is not a commercial production release and has not been submitted to Google Play.

### Installation

Download the attached `.apk` release asset. On Android, approve installation from the browser or file manager if prompted. Download only from this official GitHub repository. The file is signed by the existing Expo EAS build credentials.
